cross_mode.command:
/usr/bin/ruby -rjson -e '
rows = ARGV.map { |root| JSON.parse(File.binread(File.join(root, "summary.json"))) }
raise "four-point roster differs" unless rows.size == 4
results = []
[[0,2],[1,3]].each do |left_index,right_index|
  left=rows.fetch(left_index).fetch("recursive_dynamic_oracle")
  right=rows.fetch(right_index).fetch("recursive_dynamic_oracle")
  raise "frame mismatch" unless left.fetch("requested_frame_bytes")==right.fetch("requested_frame_bytes")
  lp=left.fetch("helper_output").fetch("profiles")
  rp=right.fetch("helper_output").fetch("profiles")
  raise "profile mismatch" unless lp.map{|p|p.fetch("id")}==rp.map{|p|p.fetch("id")}
  count=0; total=0
  lp.zip(rp).each do |a,b|
    %w[normal_part type_only_part].each do |role|
      left_path=a.fetch(role).fetch("path"); right_path=b.fetch(role).fetch("path")
      names=Dir.children(left_path).sort
      raise "file roster mismatch" unless names==Dir.children(right_path).sort
      names.each do |name|
        l=File.join(left_path,name); r=File.join(right_path,name)
        raise "nonregular source" unless File.file?(l)&&File.file?(r)&&!File.symlink?(l)&&!File.symlink?(r)
        x=File.binread(l); y=File.binread(r)
        raise "byte mismatch #{a.fetch("id")}/#{role}/#{name}" unless x==y
        count+=1; total+=x.bytesize
      end
    end
  end
  results << {frame_bytes:left.fetch("requested_frame_bytes"),parts:16,files:count,bytes_per_mode:total,actual_bytes_equal:true}
end
puts JSON.generate({format:"w242_generated_cross_mode_bytes_v1",results:results})

root_native_type_only.command:
/usr/bin/ruby -e '
require File.expand_path("scripts/probe_object_recursive_dynamic_w242.rb", Dir.pwd)
m=ProbeObjectRecursiveDynamicW242
root=ARGV.fetch(0)
s=m.parse_evidence_json!(File.binread(File.join(root,"summary.json")),"sealed capture")
probe=m::Probe.allocate
parts=s.fetch("recursive_dynamic_oracle").fetch("helper_output").fetch("profiles").flat_map do |p|
  profile=m::W241::PROFILES.find{|v|v.fetch(:id)==p.fetch("id")}
  %w[normal type_only].map{|role|{profile:profile,role:role}}
end
probe.instance_variable_set(:@recursive_parts,parts)
raw=File.binread(File.join(root,"invocations","recursive_direct_types.stdout"))
baseline=probe.send(:validate_recursive_direct_oracle!,raw)
target=raw.lines.find{|line|line.start_with?("#{m::RECURSIVE_DIRECT_TYPE_TAG}\tmap_s0\tnormal\t1\t")}
raise "type-only target absent" unless target
fields=target.chomp.split("\t",-1)
raise "unexpected native type witness" unless JSON.parse([fields.fetch(12)].pack("H*"))==["Int64","String"]
fields[12]=JSON.generate(["UInt8","String"]).unpack1("H*").upcase
mutant=raw.sub(target,fields.join("\t")+"\n")
value_fields_unchanged=(target.chomp.split("\t",-1).values_at(8,9,13)==fields.values_at(8,9,13))
raise "logical values changed" unless value_fields_unchanged
begin
  probe.send(:validate_recursive_direct_oracle!,mutant)
  raise "type-only false accept"
rescue m::Failure=>e
  raise unless e.message.include?("native nested Dynamic children differ at pk 1")
  puts JSON.generate({genuine_direct_rows:baseline.fetch(:direct_rows),genuine_typed_rows:baseline.fetch(:typed_rows),type_only_mutant_rejected:true,json_value_fields_unchanged:value_fields_unchanged,error:e.message})
end
' '/private/tmp/crystal-click-w242-debug32-seal.CKWtRp'
